title: Physics-Informed Deep Learning for Shear Wave Speed Estimation in MR Elastography
abstract: arXiv:2611.26111v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Objective: Magnetic Resonance Elastography (MRE) is a non-invasive imaging technique for mapping biomechanical properties of in vivo tissue, including shear wave speed (SWS), but involves intrinsically slow data acquisition and an ill-posed wave inversion. Instead of relying on handcrafted image priors, we propose a data-driven approach jointly combining image reconstruction and MRE inversion for robust SWS estimation from undersampled k-space data. Methods: Our physics-informed reconstruction framework comprises two blocks: a model-based neural network (NN)-regularized reconstruction module and a phase-gradient inversion (k-MDEV) calculating SWS from the reconstructed images. Concatenating both blocks yields an end-to-end trainable method to estimate SWS directly from measured k-space data. translated_title: 物理信息深度学习用于磁共振弹性成像中的剪切波速度估计
translated_abstract: 目的：磁共振弹性成像是一种无创成像技术，用于绘制活体组织的生物力学特性，包括剪切波速度（SWS），但其数据采集本质上较为缓慢，且波场反演是一个病态问题。我们不依赖手工设计的图像先验，而是提出一种数据驱动的方法，将图像重建与MRE反演相结合，从欠采样的k空间数据中稳健地估计SWS。方法：我们的物理信息重建框架包含两个模块：基于模型的神经网络（NN）正则化重建模块，以及从重建图像计算SWS的相位梯度反演。将两个模块级联后，即可得到一种端到端可训练的方法，直接从测量的k空间数据估计SWS。我们在回顾性高度欠采样的脑部MRE数据上对该方法进行了评估，并将其与基于全变分（TV）最小化的方法进行了比较。
tldr: 提出了一种端到端可训练的物理信息深度学习框架，将欠采样k空间数据的图像重建与MRE相位梯度反演相结合，可直接从测量数据稳健地估计脑组织剪切波速度。
en_tdlr: An end-to-end trainable physics-informed deep learning framework that jointly combines image reconstruction and MRE inversion to robustly estimate shear wave speed directly from highly undersampled k-space data.
